payload.description:
As a household member, I want to read my computer record after a Front Door recycle, so I can recover computer_id and stopped state without a remembered handle.

Feature: Channels and the message store

Scenario: A user's computer can be read after a Front Door recycle
  Given an empty control plane backed by a durable messaging store with HTTP
  And tenant "anthus" user "ryan" has a bot named "Researcher"
  And tenant "anthus" user "ryan" household computer is stopped
  When a recycled Front Door serves the same messaging store
  Then tenant "anthus" can read the household computer for user "ryan"

Not included: staging, production, Fargate, Safari.
payload.title: Read the household computer after Front Door recycle
